title: E-FRC-0190: spontaneous emission into the exactly linear husk light: a stand-in emitter decays at A = omega^3 $|d|^2$...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0190 in the gauge arena: spontaneous emission into the exactly linear husk light: a stand-in emitter decays at A = omega^3 |d|^2 / (18 pi $c^3$), the rate the husk symbol predicts with c = sqrt(2 kappa / 3) and eps0 = 6, isotropic across link directions, for a one-link dimer and for the stand-in hydrogen 2p -> 1s, where the D4 bulk beside it goes as omega^4.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
